about_the_game:
Ludaro: Trials of the Eternal Board 🎲✨

The dice are in motion. The board is shifting. Every choice, every roll, every twist brings you closer to victory—or disaster.

🌀 Every roll is an opportunity—but will you take it?

🃏 Stack game-changing powers, defy the odds, and rewrite the rules.

💀 The board is alive, and it won’t go down without a fight.

🎯 Wishlist now and prepare for the trials ahead!

250+ Unique and Mind blowing Spirit Cards

🃏 Spirit Cards: Where Power is Born

With each passing round, you’ll collect Spirit Cards—artifacts of pure chaos and strategy that reshape the game itself.

✨ Double, triple, or even square your best rolls.

🌀 Alter the board, creating pathways to untold riches.

🐾 Summon mysterious creatures that grant unexpected bonuses.

🎭 Stack passive effects until reality bends to your will.

No two runs are the same. No two players will ever take the same path to victory.

Pawns have special abilities and there are tons of them 

🎲 Roll the Dice, Play Your Way

Rolling the dice isn’t just about luck—it’s about timing, planning, and taking the right risks.

• You always know what’s still possible—but never what comes next.

• Play it safe, or push your luck for massive rewards.

• Every roll is a moment of strategy—will you take control, or embrace the chaos?

The right move at the right time can change everything. Will you take the risk?

Hand Crafted Fun Unique Characters

💀 The Rules Keep Changing… Can You Keep Up?

Every so often, a new challenge strikes, forcing you to adapt.

⚡ Certain rolls become unusable.

🔥 Your gains get slashed in half.

🌀 The board transforms beneath your feet.

Each time you outmaneuver the chaos, you grow stronger.

Will your Spirit Cards be enough to defy the board itself?

Open Exciting Packs for the surprises

🎁 Stack Powers, Build Your Own Luck

Along the way, you’ll unlock wild and unpredictable upgrades that push every run to new heights.

🎴 Spirit Cards that change the way you play.

⚡ Abilities that make every roll stronger, riskier, or more rewarding.

🐾 Creatures that reshape the board and unlock hidden opportunities.

🎭 Effects that combine, stack, and lead to explosive turns.

Will you craft a strategy built for success, or embrace the chaos and see where the dice take you?

Can you beat the score to be the ultimate Champion !

🌀 Features

✅ A Tactical Dice System – Rolling isn’t just luck—it’s about timing, risk, and strategy.

🔥 Ever-Changing Challenges – The board, the rules, and the game itself shift as you play.

🃏 Stackable Power-Ups – Spirit Cards combine in wild and unexpected ways.

💀 Challenging Boss Rounds – Survive game-altering twists that force you to rethink your strategy.

🎲 High-Risk, High-Reward Gameplay – Fortune favors the bold. How far will you push your luck?

WISHLIST LUDARO TO BEGIN THE EPIC JOURNEY

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon R5
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Ludaro is a roguelike deck-building dice game with a unique twist on Ludo! Plan your moves, manipulate deterministic dice rolls, and unleash powerful hand cards to beat the score. Upgrade tiles, collect quirky pets and stack wild combos as you battle in epic boss fights with game-changing modifiers.

English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*
